root_cause_criterion.obligation: For <, <=, >, and >= comparisons, make_cmp must require cs->n_values > 0 before it can read cs->values[0].masked.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed non-equality branch rejects an empty macro-backed constant set with if (!cs->n_values) before the masked-flag read executes.

nodes.description: The masked-flag read executes while the constant-set element count is still zero, so element 0 is not a valid initialized member of the parsed set.

edges.description: The same cs->n_values count observed at the missing non-empty guard is the count still in force when make_cmp reaches the masked-flag read.
The number of members contributed by the address-set macro is the constant-set count that make_cmp later relies on when it should enforce the non-empty-set guard.
